title: Pilot Study of Virtual Reality Therapy for Students With Anxiety
official: Pilot Study of Virtual Reality Therapy for Students With Anxiety
summary: The purpose of this study is to assess changes in self-reported anxiety over the course of six virtual reality (VR) sessions and to assess changes in academic self-efficacy, as well as examine the feasibility and acceptability of a relatively short and time intensive VR intervention (i.e.,six sessions over the course of three weeks) for reducing anxiety symptoms in college students.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* enrolled in The University of Texas Health Science Center School of Public Health San Antonio regional campus
* competent in English
* total score of at least 3 on the Generalized Anxiety Disorder (GAD-2)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Currently receiving psychological treatment for anxiety symptoms, or has received treatment in the last year.
* Report photosensitive epilepsy.
* Report stereoscopic vision or balance problems
sponsor: The University of Texas Health Science Center, Houston
